title: On (fake) Stationarity in Stochastic Volterra Equations with Affine Drift and Regular Kernels
summary: We investigate the fake stationarity properties of solutions to forward Stochastic Volterra Integral Equations (SVIEs) with affine drift and long-memory (regular) kernels, both on finite horizons and in the long-run regime.
